name: Propush.me
description:
Propush.me is a push and in-page traffic monetization platform for publishers. This connector links your Propush account to Claude: you ask in plain language, and Claude reads your sites, zones, balance and statistics — grouped by date, country, OS, site or zone — and helps you act on the numbers. With your confirmation it also creates onclick zones and manages postback URLs, one zone at a time or in bulk. It can pull the weekly trending-GEOs market digest and search the bundled Propush help docs, so setup questions get answered right in the conversation.

Typical prompts: "Show my revenue by country for the last 7 days". "Which of my zones earned the most this month?" "Create an onclick zone for my site". "Set the postback URL for zone 123". "What GEOs are trending in push traffic right now?"

Requires a Propush.me publisher account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Propush.me to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Propush.me to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.propush.me/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Propush.me MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Propush.me lists 17 MCP tools, including bulk_delete_zones_postback, bulk_set_zones_postback, create_onclick_zone, delete_zone_postback, get_balance, get_constructor, get_constructors, get_countries, get_me, get_os, get_sites, and get_statistics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Propush.me?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Propush.me in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Propush.me requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Propush.me is developed by PropellerAds. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
